metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2025 · House of Guinness
metas.description: Follows the aftermath of the death of brewery mogul, Sir Benjamin Guinness, and the profound impact of his will on the fate of his four adult children: Arthur, Edward, Anne and Ben.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2025 · Death by Lightning
metas.description: Dramatizes the stranger-than-fiction true story of 20th U.S. President James Garfield, and admirer Charles Guiteau, who assassinated him.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2025 · Apple Cider Vinegar
metas.description: The life of wellness guru Belle Gibson, who had a large social media following, where she pretended to be suffering from cancer but keeping the disease under control using self-care therapies. She confessed that none of it was true.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2025 · Aka Charlie Sheen
metas.description: After 7 years sober, Charlie Sheen candidly discusses his rise to fame and public downfall, joined by family and friends who share untold stories of his journey through stardom, struggles, and redemption.

metas.name: ★ 6.4 · 2025 · The Monster of Florence
metas.description: As a serial killer strikes terror in Italy by targeting couples parked in lovers lanes, authorities explore a case from 1968 that may be key to identifying The Monster of Florence.
